int_name: N 19TH ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with a marked crosswalk and traffic signals. Pedestrian safety is hindered by significant sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing and debris on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: A large food truck is parked immediately adjacent to the marked crosswalk, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk debris
hazards.description: Trash bags and loose debris are piled on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking path.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and near the gutter.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crosswalk to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracks and resurface the roadway to improve safety for all users.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals. A large tree at the corner creates a significant visual obstruction, and the wide roadway width increases exposure time for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree at the corner significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side corner of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Road Surface Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could present a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles while improving visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder patterns for better driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps, providing essential pedestrian infrastructure in a mixed-use environment. However, the safety of the environment is compromised by significantly degraded pavement and potential sightline obstructions from vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and surface degradation in the roadway and crosswalk area create trip hazards and uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb line

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk area to eliminate trip hazards and provide a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure within a mixed-use urban setting. However, safety is compromised by the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and significant sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb right up to the crosswalk block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right and left curbs approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven asphalt within the crosswalk area create trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals which may lead to confusion or conflicts.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing instructions.
